item.title: GovBrief Today #583
item.description: Do you remember the 21st night of September? Donald Trump stood at Charlie Kirk's memorial that night and told tens of thousands of mourners, "I hate my opponents, and I don't want the best for them." The same day his administration announced it would tie Tylenol to autism. If either one has blurred into everything since, that is the point. Do You Remember? at govbrief.today/remember pulls one headline at random from the 8,984 I've written since January 2025, asks whether you remembered it, and gives you a link to share it. You can pick how far back it reaches, or ask it only for something good or for someone who fought back. Testing it, one card that came up was Silverio Villegas González, 38, shot by an ICE agent at a traffic stop outside Chicago last September, minutes after dropping his child at daycare. Homeland Security said he dragged an agent and seriously injured him. On police bodycam the agent called it "nothing major." I wrote that headline and still had to click "I forgot." Flooding the zone works. Rest in peace, Silverio. I've emailed 8,984 stories over 583 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. Subscribe (It's free!): https://gbounacos.substack.com/ BRAND NEW: https://govbrief.today/remember/ [1] https://go.govbrief.today/putin-jared-witkoff [2] https://go.govbrief.today/huckabee-terrorists [3] https://go.govbrief.today/world-map [4] https://go.govbrief.today/iran-war-sep5 [5] https://go.govbrief.today/namibia-aid [6] https://go.govbrief.today/ecuadorian-boats [7] https://go.govbrief.today/vance-child-subsidy [8] https://go.govbrief.today/kenctr-ceiling [9] https://go.govbrief.today/tulsa-health [10] https://go.govbrief.today/arch-notice Subscribe (It's free!): https://gbounacos.substack.com/

Hello friendos, for the past year, I’ve been working on a game that’s very close to my heart. I describe it as a single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. You are presented with subjects and ask to kill or spare them. You are given access to their personal items, voice messages, phones, chats and given a simple instruction: which decision will benefit society the most? So you don't only have to judge the situations from moral stand point but also from a societal one. the shorter version i seen it described is Portal, but instead of portals, you murder people. Lantronix SD624 Audio Kit SOM inside Flock Safety camera
Taoglas AP.17E GPS module inside Flock Safety camera

https://www.cehrp.org/dissection-of-flock-safety-camera/ Back of Flock Safety camera showing antenna connector for cellular modem and connector for solar panel Here’s the list of component parts that we were able to identify: Cellular: NimbeLink Skywire LTE modem – FCC ID N7NHL7648 P/N: NL-SW-LTE-S7648 (https://nimbelink.com/products/4g-lte-cat-1-att-sierra-wireless/) Battery: PHD Energy lithium ion rechargeable – 10.8V, 19Ah, 205.2Wh SD624 Audio Kit SOM (https://www.lantronix.com/products/open-q-624a-development-kit/) Wifi/bluetooth: LITE ON Technology WCBN3510A 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac 2T2R+BT V4.2LE GPS: Taoglas AP.17E – one stage 17mm active patch antenna Module (https://www.taoglas.com/product/ap-17e-gps-1-stage-active-patch-17mm-2/) Camera lens: 5MP Action Camera Lens 16mm Fixed M12 1/2 Inch IR Filter Updated July 12, 2026, with a link to GitHub code for a newer version of a Flock camera: https://github.com/kernelstub/FlockCamRE
